templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum — terms that supplement an existing agreement to govern the provision and use of AI services.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement (BAA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement — HIPAA-aligned terms between a covered entity and a business associate that safeguard protected health information.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement (CSA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement — terms governing the provision and use of a cloud-based software service.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
templates.description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement — terms covering the processing of personal data on behalf of a customer in compliance with applicable data protection laws such as GDPR and CCPA.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Cover Page
templates.description: Common Paper Mutual NDA Cover Page — fillable cover page that the parties complete and sign to incorporate the MNDA Standard Terms.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — Standard Terms
templates.description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement — reciprocal confidentiality obligations between two parties exchanging confidential information.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement — terms governing a business or referral partnership between two companies.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement — terms for a short, limited trial of a product or service between a vendor and a prospective customer.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement (SLA)
templates.description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement — service availability commitments, support response times, and credits or remedies for cloud-delivered services.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement — terms for licensing on-premises or downloadable software to a customer.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement — terms for collaboration between a company and a customer who provides feedback to help shape an early-stage product.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement (PSA)
templates.description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement — terms governing the delivery of professional services such as consulting or implementation under one or more statements of work.
